item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. Highs this afternoon range from forty-three to forty-four degrees with mostly cloudy to cloudy skies and a chance of rain or rain and snow showers in some areas, while Essex County sees partly sunny conditions and only a slight chance of precipitation. Tonight, expect lows between twenty-seven and thirty-two degrees under mostly cloudy or cloudy skies with only a slight chance of precipitation. Precipitation amounts today will be light, generally less than a tenth of an inch where showers occur.
